hypothesis: Observed ancestry reference information carried by ancestry-time-aware whole-tree context can improve the frozen, selected genomic smoothing baseline. Genuine ordered ancestral correspondence must separately outperform geometry controls to justify that mechanism.
method: Fixed FP32 whole metric-tree reference affinity over native observed nodes versus census350-conditioned query/younger-reference locations, plus an age-free weighted-TMRCA control and query-context correspondence sham. All four fitted arms use identical observed84younger/12older proxy reference classes, inverse-class balancing, within-query-age centered8channel context and a zero-init bias-free8to4 correction head over frozen H025 smoothing. No baseline-logit head input. Young-scale350 and old-scale1400 generations are fixed before fit.
novelty_assessment: Metric-tree exponential reference affinity and linear residual correction are established discovery tools. The reference field is close to the released ARGMix TmrcaKernelWeighted baseline. H026 is not claimed as a novel whole-tree GNN. It asks whether ancestry-census conditioning carries useful biological signal. A future edit-driven ordered-tree mechanism needs a distinct implementation, prior-art check and informative matched controls.
repeat_policy: New information route and correction head, not an unchanged H025 rerun. One optimizer seed101, matched TRAINtile budget and same original full-support metrics. No additional seeds or FP64 sweep. Stop unchanged development if genuine geometry remains indistinguishable or all arms worsen.

protocol.observed_reference_labels: pure96 only, never query/context ancestry truth
protocol.scoring_support: same retained original100bp centers and clipped physical bins as nativeARGMix
protocol.selection: earliest minimum equal-parent developmentVAL Present64 exact-span NLL
protocol.query_context_sham: age-matched diploid-block derangement, shared fixed permutation before fitting
protocol.context_centering: per physical readout, observed actual query-age group mean subtraction, transductive unlabeled context

mechanism_contrasts.census_minus_age_free: effect of saturating young query/reference distance when their observed MRCA is younger than350, beyond removing referenceage reweighting

normalization_finding: Old-reference census/query-age shifts differ by a rowconstant and cancel after source normalization. The oldproxy context is mathematically identical in native/age_free/census arms before querymean centering. For young refs withMRCA>350, census weights normalize to exp(-2MRCA/350), so a separate agefreecontrol is necessary to isolate sub350clamping.
